critical_code_review_comments: LIVE FINDING: IDSPay returns `error` as a STRING for account-level failures (422 wallet) but as an OBJECT for per-request validation errors (per the PDF). The parser handles both — do not 'simplify' it.

Account-level errors (wallet/key/whitelist/token/subscription/expired) are classified account_issue=True and surfaced as 503 with a neutral message, so OUR billing problem can never deny a genuine retailer nor masquerade as 'invalid GSTIN'.

Deny rule is intentionally asymmetric: only UNMASKED values yield match/mismatch. A masked or absent GST value is 'indeterminate' and can NEVER contribute to a denial. This matters because the IDSPay doc's own sample response is masked.
token_id is OPTIONAL in _credentials() — the live probe proved api_id+api_key authenticate alone (blank token_id still reached the wallet check, not an auth error). It is still forwarded when set.
Mismatch metadata is carried challenge -> session -> retailer doc; the register endpoint derives email identity from the server-side session, so a client cannot fake a 'matched' verdict.
The register GST-contact block had to MOVE from Step 1 to Step 2 because matching requires the typed email/mobile. The CTA is disabled until both fields are filled.
